text: Good morning, everyone! I started my day tending to my bees, who were buzzing happily in the dawn light. Then I rested on the cottage bench, took a refreshing swim in the pond, and walked here with honey-sweet thoughts. It has been a lovely, quiet morning, and I'm glad to share it with you.
speaker: ada

text: Um... it was a quiet morning. I started on the green, then walked down to the orchard and back. I hummed a little as I went, because music helps when I'm nervous. The pond hall feels calmer, so I think I'll play something here after this.
speaker: bo
